## Result and scope

Describe the behavior or documentation change and the workstream affected.

## Contract compatibility

State whether accepted API/demo/financial/evidence boundaries change. Link the decision and affected-owner review for proposed changes; publication does not approve v1.1 drafts.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results, including skipped checks or failures. For UI changes, identify mocked versus live behavior and attach useful evidence.

## Integration and handoff

Describe effects on other workstreams, remaining blockers and any CURRENT_STATE/migration/setup updates. Confirm no credentials, private truth exposure or unrelated teammate edits are included.
